notes.title: QoL Update is Out with More to Come!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/3663b0a74b7cf289141c4ae89ff9b113a9c1f373.png[/img]


Hello, Aspirant Ballionaires (and those already in the 1%),

Before we get to the full list of updates that dropped today, we also wanted to announce our first Content Update, titled the [i]Spring Content Update[/i] (yes yes, we know, we're very creative), coming [b]April 9th[/b]! We are adding [b]one new board[/b] and [b]20 new triggers[/b] for you to play your little hearts out with!

But for now, here's what has been rolled out!

[h2]Bans[/h2]
[list]
[*] There has been an outspoken need to improve control over the board, especially at higher levels when your draft pool is…well… MASSIVE. Well GUESS WHAT? You can now ban unlocked triggers and boons from your profile tab! Use bans to hone your perfect collection of triggers and boons to make number go more up than ever. You asked, we answered.  
[/list]
[h2]Steam Workshop[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steam Workshop is official launched and ready for you to jump in and get your hands mucky! 
[*] A few “unofficial” mods have gone up from the developer to inspire you on your road to Ballionaire mod-master! Go beyond Tribute 9 in "No Frills Endless Mode" and “Lab Disasters” (Which are some nightmare-inducing Trigger mash-ups) are now available in the Steam Workshop to try!  Don’t like how they’re done? Well, try to make your own and show us up, smartypants! 
[/list]
[h2]QoL:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] We’ve finessed spawners to improve performance when HOARDS OF BALLS descend 
[*] To the folks that wanted more control over the starting screen, we’ve added UI Effects option in Display Settings. This controls the amount of animation and flashing on the title screen and game over screen! Screen shake? IN THIS ECONOMY? 
[*] For those of you who are just too good at Ballionaire and have created infinitely lasting drops, you can now end the current drop from the pause menu to avoid becoming a victim of your own success. 
[*] STREAMERS – A new setting has been added to control whether the Falling Money animation plays when the tribute is met to help with BITRATE! 
[/olist]
 

[h2]Full Patch Note List for Update 1.1.0[/h2]

[b]Bans: [/b]
- Added a "Bans" tab to Profiles that allows you to ban individual unlocked triggers and boons, if you don't want to play with them. 
- Added a button on the Unlocks screen to take you directly to the Bans page, for added visibility. 

[b]Performance: [/b]
- Smoothed out performance for massive ball spawns. 

[b]Settings: [/b]
- Rework Settings menu to create separate sections for Sound, Display, Language, Input, and Streaming. 
- Added UI Effects option in Display Settings. This controls the amount of animation and flashing on the title screen and game over screen. 
- Added Seeker Intro option in Display Settings. This controls whether the Seeker Appearing animation plays when you start a run. 
- Added Falling Money option in Display Settings. This controls whether the Falling Money animation plays when the tribute is met. (This was added for streamers because the Falling Money typically destroys a stream's bitrate). 
- Added Screen Shake slider in Display Settings. This controls the amount of screen shake. 
- Added an Input setting to fully disable all controllers (Windows only). This should help w/ folks who have unconventional inputs like a steering wheel that are interfering with mouse control in the game. 

[b]NPE/Onboarding: [/b]
- Increase the number of drops in Initiate mode from 5 to 7. Initiate mode should be a bit easier now. 

[b]Balance: [/b]
- Paper Shredder, Time Capsule, and Computer all trigger Growth Serum now. 
- Harvester is now "Bonked -> Ride the Harvester. While riding Harvester, when this ball bonks a Plant, destroy the Plant and replace it with a Seedling. Then, a random Silo gains $1,600." 

[b]In-game QOL: [/b]
- Added an "End Current Drop" button to the Pause popup, for when a drop might be stuck in an infinite loop. 
- Added 4.0x speedup setting (hotkey: 5). 
- Right-clicking during a draft choice will toggle showing/hiding the draft. 

[b]Custom Runs: [/b]
- Added "Initiate" option (e.g. none) to Tribulation Difficulty in Custom Run setup 
- Added 50% Tribute difficulty multiplier in Custom Run setup 

[b]Sound: [/b]
- LOWERED!!! THE VOLUME!!! OF THE HARVESTER!!! SOUND!!! 

[b]Localization: [/b]
- Korean now uses IM_Hyemin font. 

[b]Mods: [/b]
- Tons of work for mod support. 

[b]Bugs: [/b]
- Significant improvements to Pinball Bumper to prevent balls from passing through it. 
- Fix a really weird interaction that, while "correct", was likely causing a perception of very buggy behavior: as a rule balls can't bonk their own spawners. However, there are some weird cases, like Armored Car or Wallet, where a non-spawner trigger can spawn a ball, e.g. if a ball carrying a Wallet bonks a Pinball Bumper, the Pinball Bumper will spawn a Coin. Per the rule, the Coin would not be capable of bonking the Pinball Bumper, and create the perception that collision detection failed because the Coin would simply pass through the bumper. Now, balls are only prohibited from bonking spawners if it's a true spawner (e.g. a trigger with the Spawner trait), not just a trigger that happens to have a spawn attributed to it. This should generally be more favorable to players, and also greatly reduce the perception that Movers simply "weren't working". 
- Fixed: Gem drafts coming from Rabbit's Foot weren't being attributed to Rabbit's Foot. 
- Fixed: Mouse hover over Game Speed in HUD was not reliably bringing up the tooltip. 
- Fixed: Fixed typo in Ager definition (english)  
- Fixed: A potential Continue Game crash 
- Speculative fix: Forced the (temp) profile file to flush after writing, before renaming/moving to the real profile file. This may help some cases of people losing their save files when the game crashes. (edited)

notes.title: We Patched Some Stuff
notes.content:
We've heard your feedback, thank you. 

So let me introduce the first Ballionaire patch:

[h1]v1.0.8 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Trowel was "Whenever a trigger is removed, gain 3 rerolls.". Now, Trowel is: "The first time trigger is removed each turn, gain 3 rerolls." (Fixes infinite loops made possible by Trowel + Swiss Army Knife)
[*]Well is now Unique. (Fixes infinite loops made possible with 3+ Wells and an Abacus)
[/list]
[h3]Slot Machine:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Switch Gate is now just banned from certain parts of this board (presents as red X's during placement)
[/list]
[h3]Pinball:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Switch Gate is now just banned from certain parts of this board (presents as red X's during placement)
[*]Changes to physics colliders and overlap detection to help with stuck balls as well as Petrification/Conflagration + Dart Trap not interacting well on this board.
[/list]
[h3]Fishing:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Switch Gate is now just banned from certain parts of this board (presents as red X's during placement)
[*]The fishing line was completely "stiff" when playing on high-frequency monitors (e.g. 120+ hz). Now the fishing line should be have "normally" (slack and jiggly) regardless of framerate.
[*]Changes to physics colliders and overlap detection to help with stuck balls as well as Petrification/Conflagration + Dart Trap not interacting well on this board.
[/list]
[h2]QOL:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hold-to-Skip on joystick speed is doubled (skips kick in quicker)
[*]Any action taken on the Profile > Reset page now requires two presses of the button to confirm.
[*]Changed the way Profile > Unlocks page works. Instead of actually unlocking your content, the page presents you with an override that ignores locks when checked. This basically the game to allow all locked content to appear, without actually changing the recording of what you've legitimately unlocked. Vending Machine will still reflect actually locked content. Everything else, like Ballipedia, should behave as if the content is unlocked.
[/list]
[h2]Achievements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added an achievement for beating Ballionaire++.
[/list]
[h2]Localization:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixes in all languages.
[/list]
[h2]Bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*]FIXED: If you quickly clicked on a draft choice after hitting Reroll or Skip, you could snag the draft choice.
[*]FIXED: Rapidly clicking more than one choice from the Vending Machine draft would get the game into weird states
[*]FIXED: When Continuing a game, Rabbit's Foot would re-proc for every Animal on your board
[*]FIXED: When Continuing a game, each Silo on your board would give a Harvester draft
[*]FIXED: Balls replaced by Petrification/Conflagration would incorrectly retain the gravity of the balls they replaced in some cases
[*]FIXED: Credits typos
[/list]
Thank you for your support of our auto-bonker! 

- The Seeker

notes.title: We're Havin' a Tournament
notes.content:
You saw the title so spoiler alert. WE’RE HAVING A TOURNAMENT. 

What’s this about and why should I care you might ask. Well, gimme a minute I’m going to tell you. 

On December 2nd and 3rd, 5 content creators fight to the deat- wait, what? It’s not that kind of tournament? Pfft ok. 

Let me try that again. On December 2nd and 3rd, 5 content creators test their bonking skills to prove who is the one true ULTIMATE BALLIONAIRE and secure a donation to the charity of their choice! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723649/1a99e204b00aba39a75639a4cf492fadfbc3e599.jpg[/img]

They have 2 hours to get the highest score that they can, not a minute longer. But they don’t have to use that time all in one go. There’s a strategy to this you know! They have to play on Pyramid and Ballionaire difficulty. Thems the rules. 

Now you know the dates and the rules. Let’s tell you who and when/where you can find them: 

[h2]STREAMING SCHEDULE:[/h2]

[url=twitch.tv/celerity]Celerity[/url]:  Tues. Dec 3, 11 PM PT/2 AM ET
[url=twitch.tv/olexastream]OLEXA[/url]:  Tues. Dec 3, 3-5 PM PT/6-8 PM ET
[url=twitch.tv/skoottie]Skoottie[/url]: TBA
[url=twitch.tv/stumptgamers]Stumpt[/url]:  Mon. Dec 2, 10 AM-12 PM PT/1-3 PM ET
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@wanderbots/streams]Wanderbot[/url]: Tues. Dec 3, 1-3 PT/4-6 PM ET

We’ll be tuning in to watch these impressive feats of bonking, we suggest you do to! 

[h1]INCOMING ANNOUNCEMENT IS INCOMING[/h1]

You’ve all been waiting very patiently for us to finally have some news we can share with you about Ballionaire's launch date. And it’s time.  

Well, sort of. 

We’ll be announcing our launch date, but not today. In 4 days to be precise. You didn’t think we were just going to tell you right now, did you?  

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOG53OXk3ejdjandmNXk0bGs2ejZvMnV4d25ldWV3Y3loOTRrc2ZzYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/zP5qPFZgG3Ms35YcV3/giphy.gif[/img]

So keep your eyes peeled on the Newobject and Raw Fury social media channels, our [url=www.discord.gg/ballionaire]Discord[/url] or right here on Steam as it’s coming. LAUNCH DAY REVEAL INCOMING HYPE INITIATED!
